per_credit_hour_charges.line: Students taking only one course on a PTC campus or online will attend at a standard tuition rate of $150/credit hour.

Those students who are taking only one Dual Enrollment course at their high school or career center taught by a district employee will attend at $50/credit hour. Note: Additional charges apply at $150 for each additional credit hour for students taking more than 12 hours in a semester.
